RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, meaning sex discrimination was almost certainly not a factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect a lack of institutional gender diversity, it provides no evidence of bias against you based on sex. 

For the head of a clinical laboratory, hiring panels often prioritize broader operational management and formal leadership credentials over specialized technical qualifications like a PhD. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your administrative and leadership profile for future executive roles.
